science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Audit the psychometric drift of the primary systems.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Prevent the systemic collapse of the colony.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The dark, undulating shore of the ferrofluid sea stretches as far as the eye can see. Magnetic fields whip the metallic liquid into fractal spikes and crushing waves under a bruised alien sky. The cold air bites at the exposed skin, a constant reminder of the hostile environment.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Iridescent black spikes of ferrofluid crashing into obsidian sand.
sensory_palette.sound: The deep, grinding hum of magnetic shear ripping through the liquid.
sensory_palette.smell: Ozone and metallic tang thick in the cold air.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: Bitter, biting cold that seeps right through the thermal mesh.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A sharp, battery-acid sting on the back of the tongue.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A surging wave of solidifying metal that can be hidden behind.
A geyser of liquid metal that draws magnetic debris.
A temporary ridge of hardened ferrofluid offering a defensive barrier.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The magnetic shear is destabilizing the thermal generators.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: Without thermal stability, the colony's food reserves will freeze.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The ferrofluid sea is beginning to encroach on the Enclave itself.

reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The galley's thermal units are losing efficiency rapidly.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The field will eventually freeze the entire colony if not dispersed.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: Thermal systems shut down, spoiling the week's rations.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: You think the field is stabilizing, but it suddenly spikes, frying the control boards.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: You manage to shield the core, but the outer sensors are destroyed.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: You perfectly calibrate the thermal output to counter the shear.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Not only do you counter the shear, but you map its exact frequency for future prediction.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Silas, take the baton and see if you can reinforce the manifold.
